about: The engine's map: every part, which side it belongs to and whether it sits cleanly on that side. core: what runs a world behind the scenes (the language, the world, physics, sound, project files) and must stay fast and small. visual: everything you see (drawing, looks, film, pictures, the editor), extras that cost nothing unless used. tools: what builds and checks. status: 'in place' (one side, clean seams) or 'to separate' (mixes both sides, or lives on the wrong side). Read by tools/dashboard.py for the Loop3D Workshop dashboard; change it when a part moves.

parts.name: Basics
parts.what: maths, data files, settings, threads, the meter

parts.name: Language
parts.what: Looped Script: reading, compiling and running scripts

parts.name: Projects
parts.what: a project's cover page (.looped): its name and first scene; the library every project shares

parts.name: World words
parts.what: the script words, one file per family (words_*.cpp: settings, shapes, materials, nature, world, land, light, camera, physics, people, sound, music, story, renders); the visual families still sit beside the core ones

parts.name: World
parts.what: what a world holds: things, lights, the camera; it lives beside the film renderer

parts.name: Shapes and rays
parts.what: meshes and fast ray hits; the cook: simpler meshes, cluster trees (Nanite-style), kept by fingerprint

parts.name: Live drawing
parts.what: the WebGPU renderer, with the GPU path tracer (Ultra) mixed in

parts.name: Surfaces
parts.what: a material written as layers in real sizes (docs/SURFACES.md): the recipe, its fingerprint, the word `surface`; the patterns and the stack follow (orders M3b, M3c)

parts.name: Film renderer
parts.what: the path tracer for stills: materials, sky, film looks, shots

parts.name: Player
parts.what: the page that runs a project: the frame loop and controls, with drawing and menus mixed in

parts.name: Work budget
parts.what: what a frame costs, counted without a phone, and how far its picture is from cinema

parts.name: Command tool
parts.what: loop: check, run, play, render, budget

parts.name: Helper scripts
parts.what: Python and JavaScript helpers, to fold into loop
